name: REI
description: The original reproductive endocrinology and infertility research workspace, with Discovery enhancements.
goal: Explore reproductive health evidence, connect genetic and clinical insights, and develop answerable research questions.

ui.introduction: Explore topics, genes, or genomic regions to find evidence and shape your next question.
ui.search_label: Research topic, gene, or chromosome region
ui.search_placeholder: Try ovarian aging, PCOS, or BRCA1
ui.welcome_title: A broad interest is a good starting point.
ui.welcome_text: Search a reproductive topic to review the literature, or a gene to explore its genomic context. Save a question when a direction begins to take shape.
ui.guidance_text: Search a topic or gene to find evidence for a question your fellowship can investigate.
ui.data_hint: e.g. Clinic registry, AMH and IVF outcomes
ui.tip_text: A focused population, measurable exposure, and primary outcome make a research question easier to review with your mentor.
